title: Roger Goodell Wants the NFL to Suit Up in Japan

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Roger Goodell Wants the NFL to Suit Up in Japan
sources.description: With the NFL set to open this year’s regular season in Australia, commissioner Roger Goodell revealed another trans-Pacific stop he’d like to see: Tokyo. While attending Fanatics Fest in New York on Thursday, Goodell told Sportico he’d be interested in holding a regular-season game in Japan. Asked if there was one new international market where …
